prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: A 2019 audit found that, during the previous year, the library had ______ the program.

worlds.passage: For twenty years, a county library tracked every book and borrower with catalog software that its own technicians had written. When the library bought a commercial catalog from a large vendor in 2018, technicians did not delete the old program; they shut it down and stored it, untouched, on a basement server in case the new catalog ever failed. A 2019 audit found that, during the previous year, the library had ______ the program.
worlds.explanation: The old program was shut down but kept intact in reserve in case the new catalog failed, so the library had "mothballed" it. "Patched" fails because the program was stored untouched, with no repairs. "Outsourced" fails because nobody was operating it at all, and "repackaged" fails because it was held back unused rather than presented to anyone in a new form.

patched.why: an untouched program received no fixes

outsourced.why: a program that is shut down is run by no one, inside or outside the library

repackaged.quote: in case the new catalog ever failed
repackaged.why: it was kept in reserve, not given a new form or offered to anyone
